My dear [Miss Butler](../persons.html#237)
‘[Likes and Dislikes](../others.html#248)’ are beginning at last you see, and here is the first chapter of them, looking very inviting.

We have had great enjoyment in a visit from your cousin [Elizabeth](../persons.html#113), I only wish her back was stronger.

Are you meditating any travels this summer, the [Packet](../others.html#52) wonders in rather an interested mood.

By the by, if you have any idea, I should be glad to know what sort of number of chapters you contemplate in the present story

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
